def is_costas(x):
    n = len(x)
    # Check permutation
    if sorted(x) != list(range(n)):
        return False, "Not a permutation"
    # Check displacement vectors
    vectors = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dr = x[j] - x[i]
            dc = j - i
            if (dr, dc) in vectors:
                return False, f"Duplicate vector ({dr},{dc}) from cols {i},{j}"
            vectors.add((dr, dc))
    return True, "Valid Costas array"
